title: Kepier Hall
description: Originally founded as the Royal Kepier Grammar School under a charter from Queen Elizabeth I, established by Bernard Gilpin and John Heath. For centuries, it stood as a leading educational institution in County Durham before becoming an integral community church hall.

title: St Michael and All Angels Church
description: Dating back to Norman times, this parish church has stood at the center of Houghton-le-Spring life for over 800 years. Inside lies the tomb of Bernard Gilpin, famously known as the 'Apostle of the North' for his generosity to the poor.

title: Rectory Park & The Spring
description: The historic grounds of the former rectory, home to the natural freshwater spring that gives the town its name. Today, it offers a peaceful nature haven and community walking space connecting the town center to local heritage paths.
